conventions.units: metres, SW origin, +x east, +y north (as meta.json)
conventions.rot: radians CCW from +x about +z; model long axis = local +x
conventions.polys: [[x,y],...] counter-clockwise, not closed unless noted (enceinte is closed)

enceinte.note: Suggested circuit for palisade/stone wall: just outside the core tofts, pushed out to the brow of the rise so attackers climb to it. Gates where roads cross.
Suggested circuit for palisade/stone wall: just outside the core tofts, pushed out to the brow of the rise so attackers climb to it. Gates where roads cross.

hamlets.name: Wychcote
hamlets.note: Blue's safe farm: a woodland clearing up Wychwood Bottom, hidden from the red bank; little land, few recruits.

hamlets.name: Harrow Grange
hamlets.note: Blue's rich grange on Harrow Field: best arable on the map, but open cavalry ground 900 m from Stane Ford.

hamlets.name: Beckfoot
hamlets.note: Red's sheltered farm in the Rook Beck valley below Rookham; covered from the bridge by the Knap.

hamlets.name: Hobsgarth
hamlets.note: Red-bank farm under Blackfell, far from Rookham and one ford from Ashby: whoever holds Hob's Ford owns it.

sites.name: Crake Mill
sites.note: Watermill on Crake Gill 600 m above the bridge: grinds for whoever holds it (+food), but it sits in a gully the Knap and the bridgehead overlook.

sites.name: Tor Knap Keep (ruin)
sites.note: Shell keep on the Knap summit: commands bridge, Moss and Rook Beck; roofless, can be refortified.

sites.name: Gallows at the Gap
sites.note: Gibbet on the road through the Gap: a landmark every scout can range from.

sites.name: St Hob's Chapel
sites.note: Wayside chapel at the Holloway's mouth: last cover before the bridge flats; a small shrine (mana).

bridges.name: Harrow Bridge
bridges.note: Timber trestle road bridge on the narrow deep reach; the only dry crossing. Burnable (demolish 40 man-h), rebuildable in stone.

fords.name: splash on Bridge Road
fords.note: shallow beck crossing (wet feet, slows carts); a stepping-stone or plank crossing

fords.name: splash on Stane Street
fords.note: shallow beck crossing (wet feet, slows carts); a stepping-stone or plank crossing

fords.name: splash on Mere Road
fords.note: shallow beck crossing (wet feet, slows carts); a stepping-stone or plank crossing

woodland_hints.note: Wychwood Bottom (south): Ashby's close timber, in the valley below the town.
Wychwood Bottom (north): bigger stand, but toward Hob's Ford and the river.
Hanger wood on Harrow Ridge's SW flank: safe behind the crest, steep hauling.
Hanger Knoll wood: Rookham's timber, 800 m west of the town.
Rook Beck hanging wood below Rookham: close and covered.
Cold Knowe's north-east wood: large, but on the far side of the Gap.
Mere-side wood on the moraine: neutral timber between the mere and the Knap.

land_use_must: leave every `reserved` polygon free of trees, crops and hedges (paint its `surface` if given)
paint roads with their width: highway/track -> dirt_track, hollow_way -> hollow_way, causeway -> dirt_track raised over marsh, village_street -> village_street, path -> short_meadow worn
put woodland on `woodland_hints` (the lumber_site markers sit on their town-facing edges)
hamlet `infield_hint` rings are good arable; town crofts are kitchen_garden/orchard
settlements_provides: town halls, plots, roads, crossings, resource nodes; objects.json for placement
